fields.name: aws_auth
fields.description: Enable AWS Sigv4 Authentication for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

fields.name: aws_external_id
fields.description: External ID for the AWS IAM Role specified with aws_role_arn.

fields.name: aws_profile
fields.description: AWS profile name.

fields.name: aws_region
fields.description: Specify the AWS region for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

fields.name: aws_role_arn
fields.description: AWS IAM Role to assume to put records to your Amazon cluster.

fields.name: aws_service_name
fields.description: Service name to be used in AWS Sigv4 signature. For integration with Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, set to aoss. See the FAQ section on Amazon OpenSearch Serverless for more information.

fields.name: aws_sts_endpoint
fields.description: Specify the custom STS endpoint to be used with STS API for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

fields.name: buffer_size
fields.description: Specify the buffer size used to read the response from the OpenSearch HTTP service. Use for debugging purposes where it's required to read full responses. The response size grows depending of the number of records inserted. Set this value to False to set an unlimited amount of memory. Otherwise set the value according to the Unit Size specification.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism. Allowed value: gzip. Enabling compression reduces network bandwidth usage but might increase CPU usage.

fields.name: current_time_index
fields.description: Use current time for index generation instead of message record.

fields.name: generate_id
fields.description: When enabled, generate _id for outgoing records. This prevents duplicate records when retrying.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target OpenSearch instance.

fields.name: http_passwd
fields.description: Password for user defined in http_user.

fields.name: http_user
fields.description: Optional username credential for HTTP basic authentication.

fields.name: id_key
fields.description: If set, _id will be the value of the key from incoming record and generate_id option is ignored.

fields.name: include_tag_key
fields.description: When enabled, append the Tag name to the record.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Index name, supports Record Accessor syntax from 2.0.5 or later.

fields.name: logstash_dateformat
fields.description: Time format, based on strftime, to generate the second part of the index name.

fields.name: logstash_format
fields.description: Enable Logstash format compatibility. This option takes a boolean value: True/False, On/Off.

fields.name: logstash_prefix
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, the index name is composed using a prefix and the date. For example, if logstash_prefix is equal to mydata your index will become mydata-YYYY.MM.DD. The last string appended belongs to the date when the data is being generated.

fields.name: logstash_prefix_key
fields.description: When included, the value of the key in the record will be evaluated as key reference and overrides logstash_prefix for index generation. If the key/value isn't found in the record then the logstash_prefix option will act as a fallback. The parameter is expected to be a record accessor.

fields.name: logstash_prefix_separator
fields.description: Set a separator between logstash_prefix and the date.

fields.name: path
fields.description: OpenSearch accepts new data on HTTP query path /_bulk. It's possible to serve OpenSearch behind a reverse proxy on a sub-path. This option defines such path on the Fluent Bit side. It adds a path prefix in the indexing HTTP POST URI.

fields.name: pipeline
fields.description: OpenSearch lets you set up filters called pipelines. This option defines which pipeline the database should use. For performance reasons, it's strongly suggested to do parsing and filtering on Fluent Bit side, avoid pipelines.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target OpenSearch instance.

fields.name: replace_dots
fields.description: When enabled, replace field name dots (.) with underscores (_).

fields.name: suppress_type_name
fields.description: When enabled, mapping types is removed and the type option is ignored. OpenSearch 2.0 and later no longer support mapping types, so this should be set to On for these versions.

fields.name: tag_key
fields.description: When include_tag_key is enabled, this property defines the key name for the tag.

fields.name: time_key
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, each record will get a new timestamp field. The time_key property defines the name of that field.

fields.name: time_key_format
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, this property defines the format of the timestamp.

fields.name: time_key_nanos
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, enabling this property sends nanosecond precision timestamps.

fields.name: trace_error
fields.description: When enabled, print the OpenSearch API calls to stdout when OpenSearch returns an error (for diagnostics only).

fields.name: trace_output
fields.description: When enabled, print the OpenSearch API calls to stdout (for diagnostics only).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type name. This option is ignored if suppress_type_name is enabled.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: write_operation
fields.description: Operation to use to write in bulk requests.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
